news.headline: Bank of America Drops Back Below 5% in Abivax a Week After Crossing Above It
news.summary: Bank of America disclosed to the AMF that it fell below the 5% threshold on September 9, 2026, holding 4,323,717 shares (4.96% of capital), after crossing above it on September 2 with 5.08%. The quick in-and-out through market purchases and sales looks like trading/hedging flow rather than a strategic position, so it carries little fundamental signal.

news.headline: Goldman Sachs Initiates Coverage of Abivax with Buy Rating and $155 Price Target
news.summary: Goldman Sachs started coverage at Buy with a $155 target, modelling peak obefazimod sales of about EUR 4bn in ulcerative colitis plus EUR 3.5bn potential in Crohn's disease, and said the maintenance-trial cancer signal should not impede approval or long-term uptake. The bank also flagged Abivax as a potential acquisition target while calling a solo launch viable after the July financing.

news.headline: STAT: The Drugmaker Abivax Has Still Not Been Acquired. What's Going On?
news.summary: STAT's Adam Feuerstein dissected why, nine months into a record biotech M&A year in which a roughly $20bn takeout of Abivax was widely treated as imminent, no deal has materialised - to the visible frustration of the shareholder base. The piece frames the delay as timing and process rather than a broken thesis, noting obefazimod's blockbuster commercial potential in ulcerative colitis remains intact.

news.headline: Abivax Named Among Three Top Immunology Takeover Targets in PharmaVoice Dealmaking Analysis
news.summary: PharmaVoice profiled Abivax alongside Spyre Therapeutics and MoonLake Immunotherapeutics as one of immunology's most talked-about M&A candidates, citing the ABTECT maintenance data (37% clinical remission and 48% endoscopic improvement at Week 44 among induction non-responders on 50 mg) and a roughly $25bn addressable IBD market by 2030. It notes CEO Marc de Garidel dismissed earlier 2026 Eli Lilly acquisition rumors as noise, and that the $920m July offering funds the company into 2029, reducing the urgency for a near-term sale.

news.headline: ABTECT Maintenance Part 2 Review: Obefazimod Sustains Week-44 Remission With No Dose-Dependent Malignancy Signal
news.summary: A clinical review of the Phase 3 ABTECT Part 2 maintenance package confirmed that 37.2% of induction non-responders reached clinical remission and 34.5% endoscopic remission at Week 44 on continued 50 mg obefazimod, and that dose escalation to 50 mg recaptured clinical remission in 45.5% of patients who had relapsed in Part 1. Crucially for the June malignancy overhang, the expanded exposure showed malignancy and non-melanoma skin cancer rates consistent with UC background rates and no apparent dose-dependent signal.

news.headline: Abivax Announces Positive Pre-NDA Interaction with the FDA for Obefazimod
news.summary: The FDA gave constructive feedback and aligned with Abivax on the planned submission strategy, content and format of the obefazimod NDA in moderately-to-severely active ulcerative colitis. Abivax confirmed it remains on track to file its first-ever NDA in Q4 2026, removing a key procedural uncertainty; it is still the company's most recent press release.

catalysts.label: H1 2026 financial results (after U.S. close)
catalysts.detail: Abivax reports H1 2026 results on Monday, September 21, 2026 after the U.S. market close, now less than a week away. It will show the first post-raise balance sheet (cash was EUR 491.6m at March 31, 2026 before the $920m July offering, runway guided into 2029) and the step-up in R&D and pre-launch commercial spend. Expect updates on NDA preparation, EMA filing timing, UEG Week plans and the U.S. commercial build-out - and the first chance since July 30 for management to address the M&A question and the stock's recent slide.

catalysts.label: UEG Week 2026 (Barcelona, Oct 17-20) - possible full ABTECT maintenance dataset
catalysts.detail: UEG Week 2026 runs October 17-20 in Barcelona; the late-breaking abstract window closed September 7. Abivax presented two ABTECT induction late-breakers at UEG Week 2025 and a detailed presentation of the Week-44 maintenance efficacy and full malignancy/safety database would be the cleanest way to retire the June cancer-signal overhang. No Abivax abstract acceptance or presentation has been announced yet (ACG in late October is the alternative venue).

catalysts.label: NDA submission to FDA for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis
catalysts.detail: After positive Phase 3 ABTECT induction data, the 44-week maintenance readout, the Part 2 refractory-patient dataset and the constructive pre-NDA meeting on July 30, 2026, Abivax plans to submit its first NDA for obefazimod in moderately-to-severely active UC in late Q4 2026. This is the single biggest near-term de-risking event and the gate that starts the FDA review clock. Management has reiterated the timeline at every update this year, most recently on July 30.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 financial results
catalysts.detail: Abivax's financial calendar lists Q3 2026 results for December 14, 2026. By then the FDA submission should either have happened or be days away, so the release is the natural venue for confirming the NDA filing and giving first guidance on review type and expected PDUFA timing. It also lands roughly three months before the March-2027 option expiry, making it the last scheduled financial update inside the option's life.

catalysts.label: MAA submission to the EMA for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis
catalysts.detail: Abivax guided to filing a Marketing Authorization Application in Europe in the second half of 2026, contingent on the (now positive) 44-week maintenance data. Recent communication has emphasised the Q4 2026 FDA filing without restating a precise EMA date, so exact MAA timing remains unconfirmed and could slip into H1 2027. A European filing would open the second-largest UC market and is a lower-drama but real value step; the September 21 H1 report is the likely place for an update.

catalysts.label: Phase 2b ENHANCE-CD Crohn's disease 12-week induction topline data
catalysts.detail: Topline results from the Phase 2b induction trial of obefazimod in moderately-to-severely active Crohn's disease are guided for mid-2027 (first patient enrolled October 2024). Management has explicitly pushed this from an earlier late-2026 expectation. A positive readout opens a second large indication for the miR-124 mechanism and is the main pipeline diversification event, but it likely lands near or just after the March-2027 option expiry.

catalysts.label: Potential FDA approval decision and U.S. launch of obefazimod
catalysts.detail: With a Q4 2026 filing and a standard review cycle, an FDA decision would fall roughly 10-12 months later, i.e. in H2 2027 - after the March-2027 call expiry. No PDUFA date exists yet because the NDA has not been submitted. The commercial organisation being hired since July 2026 is being built against this window, making it the ultimate approval and revenue catalyst for the equity.

pulse: ABVX closed at $106.71 on September 15, down about 10% in two sessions from $118.64 on September 11 with no company news to explain it, leaving the March-2027 $120 call roughly 11% out of the money (the stock needs about +12.5%) with around six months to expiry and a market cap near $9.2bn. The week's inputs were mixed: Goldman Sachs initiated at Buy with a $155 target on September 10 (seeing the cancer signal as no barrier to approval and flagging M&A optionality), but the same-day Euronext annual review left Abivax out of the CAC Next 20/CAC 40, removing a hoped-for passive-buying catalyst, and there is still no takeover news and no press release since the July 30 pre-NDA update. The thesis itself is unchanged - strong ABTECT induction and Week-44 maintenance data, background-level malignancy rates in the Part 2 database, FDA alignment for a late-Q4 NDA - so getting through the strike before expiry hinges on the September 21 H1 report, a full safety presentation at UEG Week (October 17-20) or ACG, the NDA landing on time, or a revived M&A story; the Crohn's readout and FDA decision both fall after expiry.
